title: RBI Streamlines Supervisory Framework by Consolidating 64 Master Directions
summary: Consolidates fragmented circulars into unified directions to reduce compliance friction for banks.

blocks.content: Consolidates fragmented circulars into unified directions to reduce compliance friction for banks.

items: RBI issued **64 consolidated Master Directions** administered by its **Department of Supervision (DoS)**.
Consolidates **628 existing circulars** across **11 categories of Regulated Entities (REs)**.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: RBI established April 1, 1935 under RBI Act, 1934 | HQ: Mumbai.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Master Directions (ongoing rulebook) vs Master Circulars (annual snapshot compilations).

blocks.quote:
Interview Focus Question: "Why is RBI consolidating circulars into Master Directions?"
💡 **Model Answer: Creates a single source of truth, eliminates obsolete mandates, and lowers compliance risk for regulated entities.**
blocks.author: Banking & Regulatory Board Panel
